title: Bionic Woman
description:
S3 E2 — The Bionic Dog
Max runs off in the Sierra Nevada mountains, Jaime and an old flame follow him into a raging forest fire.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 — Knight in Disgrace
Michael must clear himself of false drug charges.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E9 — Dead of Knight
A dancer dies from poison gas meant for Michael, who searches desperately for its source.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E8 — Trainee
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E9 — Women!
An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E10 — Dinner Date
DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E11 — Musical Mania
Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E12 — Helpful
An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E13 — Drivers
An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E14 — School Days
The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E15 — The Professor
Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E16 — Syndrome
Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E17 — Honest
Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E20 — Harder Than It Looks
The team rescues an heiress (Lori Lethin) from terrorists, only to have her insist on returning to save her terrorist lover.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E21 — Deadly Maneuvers
Mercenaries capture B.A., Face and Murdock, and hold them at a dairy farm, leaving Tawnia and Hannibal to devise a rescue.
